items.title: Chart Patterns: Building Blocks Of Technical Analysis
Kernel regression on matrix patterns
items.abstract: <jats:p>In this paper we propose a kernel-based regression model for matrix patterns (KRMP). The training algorithm is derived. The proposed model was empirically compared with traditional models. </jats:p>
